paragraphs.text: Icehaven is the northernmost island of the Domains , and the largest island after the continent of Aerona . It is separated from Aerona by a strait called the Rip . Icehaven is home to many small states, separated by this barren land's Indigenous tribes of stone giants . The two larger nations, Keld and Parma , are divided by a desolate waste, and in the south lies the wilderness of Gurdurngs . As implied by the name, Icehaven is notorious for its cold climate.

Keld - a nation of large, gray-skinned warriors taking up most of Icehaven Agderisk - a port city on the southern coast The Border Citadel - a fortification marking the eastern border of Keld Border Mountains - a range in northern Keld, bordering the sea. The Keldon Necropolis - destroyed during the Keldon Twilight . Letha - an outcast village, destroyed by the dragon Skouras . The Mountain - a lone volcano and sacred peak The Northern Wastes - desolate, frozen lands north of Keld Port Bay - A bay hosting Port City Port City - A busy port southeast of the Necropolis and east of the Mountain Rootwater - placed here after the Rathi Overlay The Skyshroud Forest - placed here after the Rathi Overlay
The Western Reaches - staging grounds for a rebel army
Parma - theocratic kingdom of the Northern Paladins on the east tip of Icehaven
The Gurdurngs - mountainous region in southern Icehaven Kvardalen - a centaur village Synar River - fed by a lake near Kvardalen
